BiblicalUsage: Omar was a grandson of Esau, the son of Eliphaz, named among the dukes of Edom in the genealogy of the nations. He was a son of Eliphaz, and his name stands among the dukes of Edom.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe Omar is one of the dukes of Edom, and his name in the genealogy shows that God recorded the nations as carefully as He recorded Israel.
Sources: Strong's Exhaustive Concordance (1890), via OpenScriptures Strong's Dictionary (CC BY-SA)
